word_overlap.replaces: the word Jaccard of addendum 4 (lowercase, words > 3 characters, no stemming) for both the paraphrase-original overlap and the choice of the lexical neighbour D
word_overlap.jaccard2: lowercase, punctuation -> space, sklearn English stop words removed, tokens of any length kept, light suffix stemming (stage13_para_nli.words2 / jac)
word_overlap.D_rule: unchanged from addendum 4 except the overlap measure: a different paper of the same field, no shared surname, jaccard2(A, D) >= jaccard2(A, paraphrase), the closest above; else the highest available. Precomputed in the table above; 381_stage13.py do_para_run reads it (code change 2026-10-30: sha256 a7b01a8f...f7a92b -> 4e0f4849d415836015d4063e16e1ae9801a1551fdb5111a6d58480d585d0055e; backup 13_stage13/381_stage13.before_addendum5_2026-10-30.py). analyses: All X3 results (addendum 4 primary G', behaviour, by token role) are reported for both the primary and the sensitivity set. Conclusions follow the primary set; a conclusion that changes between the two sets is stated as not robust.
